instructions.purpose: Remove one of the user's own connectors. A connector still waiting for approval is removed at once; an active one becomes pending_removal and stays usable until the user approves the removal with a chat command.

tool.name: remove-connector
tool.description: Takes id. Returns id and status: removed (it is gone), or pending_removal with approvalCommand and rejectCommand.

usage_rules.rule: Call list-connectors first and use an id it returned
Remove a connector only when the user asked for it
For pending_removal, quote approvalCommand and rejectCommand exactly as returned
If the tool reports a missing connector, nothing was removed: call list-connectors again

example.context: User says: "disconnect the notes server" (list-connectors returned notes, active)
